item: Institutional recommendation for developmental efforts above the breakeven
value: liquid N2 with power + liquid N2O with power
location_in_source: ICES-2026-238 p.14 (full sentence; PDF text layer count==1)
notes: verbatim: "Therefore, since long duration missions with high EVA frequency are likely to benefit most from a non-compressed gas option, this study culminated in the recommendation that liquid N2 with power and liquid N2O with power should be pursued in developmental efforts as they trade best at higher N2 requirements, have higher TRLs, and fewer safety concerns of the options considered." - chosen for best trade at high requirements, higher TRLs and fewer safety concerns than the liquid N2H4 option
